questions.stem: In the number 45,678, what is the value of the digit 6?
questions.explanation: The digit 6 is in the hundreds column, so its value is $6 \times 100 = 600$.

questions.stem: In the decimal 7.293, what is the value of the digit 9?
questions.explanation: After the decimal point, the positions are tenths, hundredths, thousandths. The 9 is in the second position after the decimal point, so it represents 9 hundredths (0.09).

questions.stem: Which of the following shows $23.456$ written in expanded form?
questions.explanation: In expanded form, each digit is multiplied by its place value: $2 \times 10 + 3 \times 1 + 4 \times 0.1 + 5 \times 0.01 + 6 \times 0.001$.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the correct ascending order?
questions.explanation: Writing with the same decimal places: 0.053, 0.300, 0.305, 0.350. Comparing: $0.053 < 0.300 < 0.305 < 0.350$.

questions.stem: Each position in a number is worth how many times more than the position to its right?
questions.explanation: Our number system is base 10, so each place value is 10 times the value of the position to its right (e.g., hundreds are 10 times tens).
Comparing digit by digit: units are the same (3), tenths are the same (4), but in the hundredths place $3.45$ has 5 while $3.405$ has 0. Since $5 > 0$, $3.45 > 3.405$.

questions.stem: How is the number 604,017 written in words?

options.text: Six hundred and forty thousand and seventeen
Six hundred and four thousand and seventeen
Six million, four thousand and seventeen

questions.explanation: 604,017 breaks down as 604 thousands and 17 units, which is read as 'six hundred and four thousand and seventeen'.
